content.title: Possible hypertension
content.body: Based on your answers you may have raised blood pressure (high pressure in your arteries). This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. A normal range sits below 120 over 80. Please see a doctor within 14 days so they can measure it properly with a cuff and decide what to do next.
recommendations: Book a clinic blood pressure check within 14 days.
Reduce added salt in your meals.
content.disclaimer: Screening questionnaire only, not a diagnosis.
